title: Juicy Argentinian Beef Toast
description: A cultured and indulgent Argentinian dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar, toast, and high-protein beef, perfect for a satisfying snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the beef strips for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the crusty bread slices until lightly browned.
Assemble the toast by placing a slice of provolone cheese on each toasted bread slice.
Top each cheese-topped bread slice with a few slices of grilled beef.
Drizzle any remaining marinade over the top of the beef and cheese.
